context.what: Pre-computed probability lookup table for the Swing Gate (Quality Swing department).
context.how: Each cell describes the historical behavior of 538 tickers when the 3 dimensions (T, C, sigma_vw) align in that configuration.
context.dimensions: T_slope (Tide, long-term) x C_slope (Current, medium-term) x sigma_vwap_wave (price position vs VWAP Wave)
context.observation_unit: 1 observation = 1 bar = 1 trading day of 1 ticker. N=628,030 = 538 tickers x ~1,167 days avg each.
context.stereotype_source: Zigzag 2.5% classifies each bar as HH (Higher-High), HL (Higher-Low), LH (Lower-High), LL (Lower-Low)
context.bull_definition: Bull = HH + HL (next high or low is higher than previous)
context.bear_definition: Bear = LH + LL (next high or low is lower than previous)
context.global_p_bull_meaning: Across all 628,030 bars, 60.78% are bull. The market has structural bullish bias.

baselines._what: Baseline zigzag pivot rates across the entire market. These are the REFERENCE for all lifts and comparisons in each state.
baselines._share_denominator: share_pct in each state = count_in_state / total_pivots x 100

band_baselines._what: Each sigma_vw band groups a range of price position vs VWAP Wave. Shows WHERE the market lives and HOW it behaves at each position.
band_baselines._meaning: If lift_vs_band ~ 1.0, T and C add NO information beyond sigma_vw. If it diverges, T x C DOES discriminate within that band.
